metrics: use 'u' suffix instead of size_t(x) SerializationUtilsTest has some code to compare the size of a std::vector with a numeric constant. To avoid the compiler warning on the signed/unsigned mismatch in the comparison, the code uses `size_t(x)`. According to https://google.github.io/styleguide/cppguide.html#Casting, `size_t(x)` or `(size_t)x` are disallowed as they prevent the compiler from checking narrowing conversions. Brace initialization `size_t{x}` is preferred instead. Alternatively, for small integer constants used in the context of ASSERT_EQ/EXPECT_EQ, it's simpler to use the 'u' suffix on the constants. BUG=None TEST=Unit tests. cryptohome: Remove temporary Drive cache before user becomes unable to create files. cryptohome::kMinFreeSpaceInbytes was used as a threshold to start cache deletion by cryptohome, but the constant is also referred by private_api_file_system.cc and some other places to detect disk space shortage. As a result, for example, Files app rejects transferring a file if disk space would go below this limit *after* file creation. So disk space will not actually be lowered to below kMinFreeSpaceInBytes by such operation. Additionally, such other service doesn't evict GCache files of other users than the current user. As a result, the user will see error saying "not enough disk space" even when disk space is occupied by other user's GCache (especially, Drive cache), while cryptohome doesn't remove cache files as disk space shortage is still not happening. This change lowers the possibility of having such situation by setting a separate threshold for cryptohome. Same issue can still happen when user attempts to create a file which is >500M when the disk space is almost 1GB, for example. BUG=chromium:533750 TEST=manual test. Fill the local disk until free space becomes between 2.5GiB and 2GiB. Pin three 512MiB Drive files and unpin them. Confirm free disk space is between 1GiB and 512MiB by "df /home -h" shell command. Then reboot and login as another user. See if the free disk space is > 2GiB. Change-Id: I594a2b8b552d83b6bca9d031f722569d5ff428e8 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/382894 Commit-Ready: Tatsuhisa Yamaguchi <yamaguchi@chromium.org> Tested-by: Tatsuhisa Yamaguchi <yamaguchi@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Keigo Oka <oka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Darren Krahn <dkrahn@chromium.org>
